Major US banks hit by sudden technical outages
China's economy falters as factory output undershoots expectations
Supreme Court rejects Trump administration bid to end DEI grants
Cyclone Akvan brews over the Bay of Bengal

articles.headline: Gold Sinks to One-Year Low Amid Dollar Surge
articles.brief: Gold prices dropped to a one-year low, driven by rising Treasury yields and a strengthening US dollar, setting the precious metal on track for its worst annual performance since 2015.

articles.headline: China's Factory Output and Retail Sales Miss Expectations
articles.brief: China's economic recovery faced renewed headwinds as both industrial output and retail sales figures undershot analyst expectations, pointing to persistent domestic demand weakness.

articles.headline: Major US Banks Hit by Online Outages
articles.brief: Customers of major US financial institutions including JPMorgan Chase and Bank of America reported widespread technical issues accessing online accounts, though banks ruled out cyberattacks.

articles.headline: Renault to Add EV Roles While Cutting White-Collar Jobs
articles.brief: French automaker Renault announced plans to create 2,000 new positions focused on electric vehicle production while simultaneously cutting up to 1,000 administrative jobs.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Rejects Trump Administration Bid on DEI Grants
articles.brief: The US Supreme Court dealt a setback to the Trump administration by leaving intact a ruling that blocked attempts to cancel billions of dollars in federal research grants.

articles.headline: US Proposes Rule Change Impacting H-1B Visa Extensions
articles.brief: The Department of Homeland Security proposed a rule change removing deference to prior visa approvals, potentially leading to increased requests for evidence and longer processing times for H-1B workers.

articles.headline: Bangladesh Garment Industry Unrest May Benefit Indian Suppliers
articles.brief: Fresh wage protests in Bangladesh have forced the closure of numerous garment factories, prompting global retailers to explore supply chain diversification toward regional competitors like India.

articles.headline: Cyclone Akvan Brews Over the Bay of Bengal
articles.brief: Meteorological authorities report that Cyclone Akvan is intensifying into a severe storm over the Bay of Bengal, prompting regional disaster management preparations.

articles.headline: Delhi Seeks World Bank Support for Regional Air Pollution Strategy
articles.brief: The Delhi government has initiated talks with the World Bank to implement an airshed-based coordination strategy with neighboring states to effectively tackle regional air pollution.

articles.headline: Drone Warfare Eliminates Safe Zones Across Sudan
articles.brief: Military analysts highlight how the escalating use of unmanned drone strikes in Sudan is expanding combat zones into residential areas, markets, and hospitals, worsening the humanitarian crisis.

articles.headline: Mitchell Santner Ruled Out of India Test Series
articles.brief: New Zealand suffered a major blow ahead of their upcoming Test series against India after all-rounder Mitchell Santner was sidelined due to a hand fracture sustained during an ODI match.

articles.headline: Grammy Award Nominations Led by Raye and Rosalia
articles.brief: Artists Raye and Rosalia have secured the leading number of nominations for the upcoming Grammy Awards, announced music industry organizers.

articles.headline: Jordan and Iraq Block Telegram Over National Security
articles.brief: Authorities in Jordan and Iraq have restricted access to the Telegram messaging application, citing growing national security concerns and failure to comply with local regulations.

articles.headline: India Hikes Export Duty on Diesel and ATF
articles.brief: The Indian government has increased export levies on diesel and aviation turbine fuel to meet domestic supply needs amidst a volatile global energy market.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Grants Bail to Two Convicts in Bilkis Bano Case
articles.brief: The Supreme Court suspended sentences and granted bail to two convicts in the Bilkis Bano case, noting they had served over 17 years in prison.
